snippet.title: The Medieval Journey - Announcement Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Build a life. Raise a family. Create a dynasty that lasts for generations.

The Medieval Journey is a living medieval MMORPG set in a world inspired by historical Germany, where your story doesn't end with a single character. Form relationships, marry, raise children and pass your name, wealth and reputation on to the next generation as your family shapes its legacy across the centuries.

Master professions, gather resources, craft goods and build businesses in a player-driven economy shaped by supply and demand. Trade between regions, establish profitable routes and work your way from humble beginnings to wealth, reputation and influence.

Explore cities inspired by medieval Germany, including Magdeburg, Lübeck, Hamburg and Lüneburg, with additional regions and cities planned as the world expands. Cooperate with other players, form guilds and alliances, build trade networks or compete for influence across cities and markets.

Wishlist The Medieval Journey now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4868880/The_Medieval_Journey/
